def test_user_register_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("username") == username

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is False

def test_catalogue_endpoints():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags = resp.json().get("tags", [])

    if tags:
        tag = tags[0]
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        assert "size" in resp.json()

        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        items = resp.json()

        if items:
            item_id = items[0]["id"]
            resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
            assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
            assert resp.json().get("id") == item_id

            image_urls = resp.json().get("imageUrl", [])
            if image_urls:
                image_url = image_urls[0]
                image_path = image_url.split("/catalogue/images/")[-1]
                resp_img = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/images/{image_path}"), timeout=10)
                assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_img.status_code}: {resp_img.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/invalid_id_123"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_add_item_and_merge():
    username = create_test_user()

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    if not items:
        pytest.skip("No catalogue items available")
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert any(i.get("itemId") == item_id for i in cart_items)

    item_payload["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 5

    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    bad_session = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/merge?sessionId={bad_session}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_create_workflow():
    username = create_test_user()

    addr_payload = {"city": "L", "country": "UK", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "S", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    card_payload = {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    if not items:
        pytest.skip("No catalogue items available")
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    item_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": unit_price}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order_data = resp.json()
    order_id = order_data.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order_data.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("id") == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in customer_orders)

    bad_payload = {
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=bad_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 406, f"Expected 406, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    bad_payload2 = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": "/addresses/invalid_format",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=bad_payload2, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_authorize():
    order_id = setup_order()
    if not order_id:
        pytest.skip("Could not setup order")

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "L", "country": "UK", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "A", "lastName": "B"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("authorised") is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0].get("orderId") == order_id

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 2

    payment_payload["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("authorised") is False
